packets.title: A mentor retirement that trains one apprentice
packets.scope: One opt-in named mentor reaches retirement date. Choose current apprentice training credit or one small local resource payout, then mentor becomes unavailable for routine lessons. Keep native player defeat unchanged.
packets.state_contract: mentor ID, retirement due time, chosen recipient, emitted milestone and transaction receipt; persist choice before rewards; duplicate execution cannot pay twice.
packets.acceptance: Before due lesson works; at due show choices with named cost/result; choose apprentice, save/reload/import retains reward and retired state; missing/dead recipient offers resource fallback; large time advance resolves once.
packets.exclusions: No universal NPC population, forced player death, automatic prestige or copied story text.

packets.title: Scars with a history and separate temporary recovery cost
packets.scope: One optional event produces an original injury annotation plus bounded recovery inconvenience; persistent mark survives recovery and points to its milestone.
packets.state_contract: injury ID, originating milestone, recoverAt, permanent annotation; timed penalty expires separately; carrier/retention policy explicit.
packets.acceptance: Recovery ends penalty once; history and annotation stay after reload/import; duplicate event does not stack injury; current native unconsciousness remains unchanged.

packets.title: Origin tags that unlock one later callback
packets.scope: One optional starting memory chooses a coherent original origin tag and one later local event callback, rather than random cosmetic biography.
packets.state_contract: record choice and tag, saved RNG selection, callback resolved receipt; required/forbidden gate visible in diagnostics.
packets.acceptance: Contradictory tags excluded; no eligible event gives a quiet no-op; later callback recognizes tag; resolve persists and cannot reroll or repeat after reload/import.

packets.title: Compact chapter records and explicit legacy carry
packets.scope: One life-record milestone type distinguishes permanent mark, present-life modifier and relationship ID. Keep annual summaries with counters rather than storing every rendered sentence.
packets.state_contract: stable event ID, year/world ID, references and carry class; preserve source milestone needed by scar; no inferred CK3-equivalent compaction claim.
packets.acceptance: Round-trip long synthetic biography through save/reload/import; present-life modifier excluded only at explicitly accepted reset boundary; broken relationship IDs degrade to remembered name; measured save-size bound.

handoff: Parent owns dispatch to current experience/foundation GMs; no src edits.
